python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,time,re
p=pathlib.Path('/var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter/teamspeak.prom')
print('Collector age_seconds:',round(time.time()-p.stat().st_mtime))
for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
 if re.match(r'^teamspeak_(local_up|public_up|dns_srv_up|query_up|last_probe_timestamp_seconds)[{ ]',line):
  print(re.sub(r'relay="[^"]*"','relay="<REDACTED_RELAY_TARGET>"',line))
PY
